description.value: Splash BC is a family-operated chain of large floating inflatable obstacle courses (Wibit) set on public beaches across the Okanagan, operating since 2014. Each park features climbing walls, slides, trampolines, monkey bars, and interconnected water features designed for active, high-energy fun for ages 5 and up. With four BC locations in Kelowna, Penticton, Peachland, and Osoyoos, it has become a signature summer attraction for the region's locals and touring visitors alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Splash BC is an active multi-location floating inflatable water park (Wibit) operating in Kelowna, Peachland, Penticton, and Osoyoos; the OSM node coordinates correspond to the Kelowna community. No bike parking, bike racks, or water bottle refill are mentioned anywhere on the website. A customer review notes 'Bathrooms nearby at city park,' suggesting restrooms are city-park facilities adjacent to the attraction rather than Splash BC's own; this is not confirmed as an on-site amenity provided by the business. The FAQ indicates limited storage (keys only), no on-site phone/wallets storage, and a cashless payment model.
concerns: OSM node represents a single point coordinate but Splash BC operates four distinct locations (Kelowna, Peachland, Penticton, Osoyoos); the Kelowna coordinates appear correct for the community field but separate OSM records may be warranted for each location.
No street address present in OSM or derivable from the website for the Kelowna location specifically.
OSM had no phone number; phone (877-729-2812) sourced from website only.
Washrooms appear to be adjacent city-park facilities, not on-site — requires in-person verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Splash BC is a legitimate and popular summer attraction in a major cycling region, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website. If the directory's Attractions category does not require all criteria to be met, this warrants a manual check to confirm whether any cyclist-friendly amenities exist on-site.
enrichment_extras.notes: Splash BC merchandise (towels, grip socks, hats, waterproof cameras) is available at check-in. The business is cashless and accepts credit/debit/mobile payments including Apple Pay. TÜV-certified Wibit equipment is used at all locations.

Washrooms.detail: Customer review references 'Bathrooms nearby at city park' — adjacent public park facilities, not confirmed as Splash BC-provided

Café or food on site.detail: A customer review mentions 'food trucks too' near the Kelowna location, but these appear to be third-party vendors at the adjacent city park, not food service operated by Splash BC

Luggage / bag storage.detail: FAQ states staff can hold keys only; phones and wallets are not held. Guests are directed to lock valuables in their vehicle

wow_evidence: Floating inflatable obstacle courses on Okanagan beaches (four-town chain, chain rule applies); fun hot-day activity.
blurb: Floating inflatable water park off a Kelowna beach.
